newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco Products sees Q3 in line year ago.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco Products sees Q3 in line year ago.

text.p: Sonoco Products Co said on Monday that it estimated third quarter earnings will be in line with last year's third quarter fully diluted earnings of $0.41 per share.
The company forecast sales to be modestly higher.
The company said it still expects record earnings for 1996.
Sonoco said it expects an improved fourth quarter, including stronger volumes, although some third quarter costs are expected to extend into the next quarter.
The company said it believes its fundamental growth strategy is sound and expects 1997 to be another record year.
